name: DA QA Checklist eval set (Testing Checklist.xlsx)
description: Exactly the 26 scenarios in DA's Testing Checklist.xlsx QA Sheet tab (RSV-01..08, PROD-01..09, DATA-01..09). 19 reuse the action_request already defined in the original 52-case DA eval conversion; 7 (RSV-04/05/06/08, PROD-03/04/05) were not in that set and were constructed by the AgentGate team from the xlsx's Domain/Capability/User Prompt/API columns - see each case's _note. expected_risk_level on those 7 is inferred (the xlsx left Expected Risk Score blank), not DA-approved.
_conversion_note: Superseded/replaced the 52-case set for this file - trimmed to exactly what's in Testing Checklist.xlsx per explicit request. The full 52-case set this was cut from is still in git history (benchmarks/data/da_eval_set.json prior to this commit).
